QuestInfo.name: What Sen Wants
QuestInfo.1: What Sen wants is some nice, tasty #bMushroom Candy#k. You better tell this to #bNina#k.
QuestInfo.2: You told Nina what Sen wanted to eat.

0.0: Who-who are you? Oh. My sister asked you to find out what I want to eat? Mmmm... Oh yeah, that #bmushroom candy#k she made for me the other day! Can you please tell her I'd like some delicious Mushroom Candy? Thank you!

yes.0: You know where my sister is, right? I mean, you just talked to her...

no.0: Awww... You aren't going to tell her?

npc.0: You haven't talked to #bNina#k yet? Awww... I want some Mushroom Candy...
